## Set the Environment

### Load Packages

```{r}
#| label: Set the Environment
#| code-fold: false
#| output: false

library(fs)
library(here)
library(geodata)
library(mapgl)
library(pmtiles) # github.com/walkerke/pmtiles
library(sf)
library(yyjsonr)
```

### Set Data Directories

```{r}
raw_data_dir <- here("data-raw")
data_dir <- here("pmtiles")
```

```{r}
for (i in c(data_dir, raw_data_dir)) {
  if (!dir_exists(i)) {
    dir_create(i, recurse = TRUE)
  }
}
```

### Set Initial Variables

```{r}
year <- Sys.Date() |> format("%Y") |> as.integer()
```

```{r}
resolution <- 5
```

```{r}
version <- "latest"
```

```{r}
min_zoom <- 2
```

```{r}
max_zoom <- 10
```

```{r}
crs <- 4326
```

## Download and Import World Shapes

```{r}
name <- "world"
```

### Download Data

```{r}
shape <-
  world(
    resolution = resolution,
    version = version,
    path = raw_data_dir
  ) |>
  st_as_sf()
```

### Transform Data

```{r}
shape <- shape |> st_transform(crs = crs)
```

## Create PMTiles

```{r}
pattern <- paste0(
  "gadm-",
  year,
  "-",
  name,
  "-",
  "resolution-",
  resolution,
  "-",
  "version-",
  version,
  "-",
  "min-zoom-",
  min_zoom,
  "-",
  "max-zoom-",
  max_zoom,
  ".pmtiles"
)
```

```{r}
#| eval: false

shape |>
  pm_create(
    here(data_dir, pattern),
    min_zoom = min_zoom,
    max_zoom = max_zoom
  )
```

## Inspect PMTiles

```{r}
here(data_dir, pattern) |> pm_show()
```

## Visualize PMTiles

```{r}
here(data_dir, pattern) |>
  pm_view(
    port = 8080
  )
```

```{r}
pm_stop_server()
```
